profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Technical Leadership · Application Architecture · Product Engineering
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer with 10+ years of experience designing and delivering secure, scalable application software across compliance, security, healthcare, and enterprise products. Technical leader experienced in guiding distributed engineering teams, owning complex product initiatives, shaping system and UX direction, and translating difficult business problems into intuitive software.
Deep experience building single-page applications with Angular and TypeScript, with additional experience in C#, Go, AWS, automated testing, APIs, and high-volume data applications. Strong product and engineering perspective with a focus on challenging legacy assumptions, simplifying complex systems, and delivering reliable software that scales.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead onshore and offshore engineering teams delivering enterprise-scale, award-winning regulatory technology using Angular, TypeScript, C#, AWS, GitHub, and Playwright.
Own and drive complex software initiatives from product and technical direction through implementation and delivery, working across engineering and product teams to keep multiple priorities aligned.
Led delivery of AI Broker Statement Import, a high-demand application capability that enables efficient ingestion and assessment of brokerage transaction data.
Developed a forward-looking product roadmap that challenges legacy database-centered UX patterns and restructures workflows around what users need to accomplish, creating a simpler and more scalable application model.
Design and build secure, accessible, scalable single-page application experiences for highly complex compliance workflows and large enterprise customers.
Partner closely with product and engineering teams to evaluate existing assumptions, identify systemic problems, and develop solutions that improve both the user experience and long-term maintainability of the platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed front-end and back-end functionality for highly secure data-breach reporting software using Angular, AngularJS, and Go.
Designed proofs of concept, application mockups, administrative tooling, and data-visualization experiences.
Built an onboarding process for new technical hires, helping engineers become productive within the development organization.

positions.title: Programmer/Developer
positions.description: I work primarily in Balsamiq, Angular and JavaScript to design, implement and release UI driven population-health software. Other duties include Scrum duties, working with marketing team to create new user friendly features.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
As a Front End Web Developer for Biamp’s newest product and first group of web controlled audio software, I worked with a great team of software and web developers to put out a leading-the-way web product that is slick, easy to use for all it does, and has the audio tech industry buzzing. http://www.biamp.com/products/oreno/index.aspx
When I joined the team, they needed a developer for the end-user UI for both tablets and phones,  and development of an administrative web application. I also worked with marketing to develop an application that allows web access to an audio system that enhances a room’s audio setup. 
Biamp is an amazing company that lets people that are go getters, go get-em. I worked on new things quite often and was inspired daily in an agile environment with a team that was just brilliant.

positions.title: Front End Web Developer - London
positions.description:
I prototyped and developed web sites, created clean and easy to read code, and did a lot of client-facing project management. I used Javascript, jQuery, CSS and HTML5 regularly. I led a weekly international web-dev meeting. I loved learning new languages and taking on projects that married critical thinking and efficiency. See my sites: 
Harley-Davidson: https://secure.ethicspoint.com/domain/media/en/gui/33305/index.html
Patagonia Works: https://secure.ethicspoint.com/domain/media/en/gui/41469/index.html
Sandvik: https://secure.ethicspoint.eu/domain/media/en/gui/101650/index.html
Heineken: https://secure.ethicspoint.com/lrn/media/en/gui/25903/index.html

positions.title: English Teacher
positions.description: At ESDC I oversaw teaching curriculum and skills improvement as a teacher and manager throughout Austria and Germany. I worked with teams from all over the world to implement high-level English language instruction.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Foundation for Tigard Tualatin Schools - SEED Program
volunteerExperiences.description: Together, we build fun apps to get kids curious about programming and design and get them thinking about the impact of the programs they write.
